shapes.title: Ark exit

insert.then: the parent is in this mempool

shapes.note: The package is what moves between sidecars. Enabling it inserts the pair here and leaves it unmarked. It does not go out on the Bitcoin port. The child is part of the package and is not itself a whitelist shape. Knots #481 treats the leaf inside an Ark hop as miniscript behind a timelock or one hash check. That class is WLS-12. This checker stays the version-3 parent with fee 0 and one zero-value anchor. The same leaf class includes JoinMarket and Boltz, so those are not inserted as this package.

shapes.title: 32-byte commitment
shapes.note: OpenTimestamps, proof-of-reserves, and RGB use this length. The length is the match, not the contents. Leave it unmarked if the node already accepted it. No extra send.

shapes.title: Empty runestone
shapes.note: OP_RETURN OP_13 and nothing after it. A real runestone, with bytes after OP_13, is spam.

shapes.title: Lightning anchor sweep

schema.witness_script: 33-byte compressed key, CHECKSIG IFDUP NOTIF 16 CSV ENDIF
schema.parent_script: P2WSH of that witness script, or P2SH of that program

shapes.note: The spending witness reveals the BOLT 3 anchor. The parent is the pay-to-witness-script-hash of that script, or P2SH of that same program. Knots #481 names this ln-anchor. Offered and received HTLCs are WLS-14, and to_local is WLS-13. Not an insert package.

shapes.title: Pay-to-anchor sweep

spends: pay-to-anchor output 51024e73 with an empty witness
taproot leaf that is only OP_TRUE, empty stack
taproot leaf that is only a small number and CSV or CLTV, empty stack

shapes.note: Three spends, one row. The output script 51024e73 with an empty witness. A taproot leaf that is only OP_TRUE. A taproot leaf that is only a small number and CHECKSEQUENCEVERIFY or CHECKLOCKTIMEVERIFY, which is the LND anchor. A leaf's stack is empty: the witness is the script and its control block. Knots #481 names the leaves anchor-true and anyone-after-timelock. Not the Ark exit, and not an insert package.

shapes.title: Dust sweep
shapes.note: More than 4 bytes in that only output is spam, not this row.

shapes.title: Rootstock PowPeg flyover

schema.witness: OP_NOTIF, a multisig of 33-byte keys, ELSE, a number, CHECKSEQUENCEVERIFY, DROP, a second multisig, ENDIF
schema.keys: 33 bytes each. A 65-byte key is not this row
schema.prefix: an optional 32-byte push and DROP, the flyover prefix

shapes.note: Knots #481 names this powpeg. The script is not checked against an address Rootstock publishes. This row clears only the fake-multisig mark. It does not copy the field budget. It stays off until turned on. Any other script stays spam.

shapes.title: Consolidation
shapes.note: Shrinks the coin set. Leave it unmarked. It is not a package and it does not get a fee credit yet.

shapes.title: Sane miniscript

schema.script: a revealed P2SH, P2WSH, or tapscript that parses as miniscript and is sane

shapes.note: Knots #481 would relay this and then count unproven keys and hashes past an allowance. An IF/ELSE of two known shapes is the same class, not its own row. This row is a name. The check is not written, and the field budget is not copied. Not an insert package.

shapes.title: Miniscript behind a timelock or one hash check

schema.around: sane miniscript, or a lone OP_TRUE
schema.also: a lone uncompressed key behind those checks, in P2SH only

shapes.note: Knots #481 names the forms miniscript-timelock, miniscript-hash, miniscript-timelock-hash, and anyone-after-checks. The leaf inside an Ark hop is this class. WLS-1 does not use it: the same shape is also JoinMarket and Boltz, and those must not be inserted as an Ark package. This row is a name. The check is not written. Not an insert package.

shapes.title: BOLT 3 to_local

schema.script: IF key ELSE <n> CSV DROP key ENDIF CHECKSIG
schema.kind: P2WSH, and the same bytes in P2SH

shapes.note: The second-stage output of a BOLT 3 local commitment. The anchor sweep is WLS-6. This row is a name. The check is not written. Not an insert package.

shapes.title: BOLT 3 HTLC

schema.kind: P2WSH, and the same bytes in P2SH

shapes.note: The four BOLT 3 HTLC scripts. The anchor output those channels also use is WLS-6, not this row. This row is a name. The check is not written. Not an insert package.

shapes.title: LND revocation leaf
shapes.note: The revocation leaf of an LND simple-taproot channel. The local key is dropped. The revocation key signs. The anchor leaf of that channel is the bare timelock on WLS-7. This row is a name. The check is not written. Not an insert package.

shapes.title: Phoenix swap-in

forms: IF <n> CSV DROP ELSE key CHECKSIGVERIFY ENDIF key CHECKSIG
the same script with CLTV in place of CSV

shapes.note: ACINQ Phoenix swap-in, version 1, in the CSV refund form and the CLTV refund form. This row is a name. The check is not written. Not an insert package.

shapes.title: Boltz submarine swap

schema.script: SIZE 32 EQUAL IF HASH160 hash EQUALVERIFY key ELSE DROP <n> CLTV DROP key ENDIF CHECKSIG

shapes.note: The Boltz submarine swap. Other hash-or-timelock swaps are WLS-18. This row is a name. The check is not written. Not an insert package.

shapes.title: Other swap scripts
shapes.note: The other swap scripts Knots #481 lists beside Boltz: a SHA256 preimage with pubkey hashes on both paths, a two-party hash-or-CSV, its NOTIF sibling, and an HTLC whose hash or timelock shares one CHECKSIG. Boltz itself is WLS-17. This row is a name. The check is not written. Not an insert package.

shapes.title: Four-path VHTLC
shapes.note: Four nested paths: two immediate 2-of-2 spends, then a key plus a SHA256 preimage after a CSV, then a key after a longer CSV. This row is a name. The check is not written. Not an insert package.

shapes.title: Selector federation

schema.script: <selector> EQUALVERIFY IF key CHECKSIG ELSE 3 of 5 CHECKMULTISIG ENDIF

shapes.note: A selector push chooses one key or a 3-of-5. This row is a name. The check is not written. Not an insert package.

shapes.title: Custodial index switch

schema.script: a chain of DUP <index> EQUAL IF DROP <branch> ELSE, then one final branch and the matching ENDIFs
branches: two key hashes checked by a shared tail

shapes.note: A witness item picks which pair of key hashes can spend. One script uses one branch form, not both. This row is a name. The check is not written. Not an insert package.

shapes.title: Liquid federation

schema.script: m-of-n CHECKMULTISIG IFDUP NOTIF <t> CSV VERIFY m2-of-n2 CHECKMULTISIG ENDIF

shapes.note: The Liquid federation layout. The emergency path is a second multisig after a CSV. Knots #481 would not charge the federation keys on the signed path. This row does not copy that exemption. This row is a name. The check is not written. Not an insert package.

shapes.title: Legacy P2SH multisig

schema.keys: 33 or 65 bytes, and only in P2SH

shapes.note: A bare legacy multisig in a P2SH redeem script. A 65-byte key in P2WSH is not a key under this policy, because segwit will not let an uncompressed key sign, so that script is not this row. This row is a name. The check is not written. Not an insert package.

shapes.title: Tapscript threshold

schema.script: (<key> CHECKSIGVERIFY)* <key> CHECKSIG (<key> CHECKSIGADD)+ then an optional k and GREATERTHANOREQUAL, NUMEQUAL, or EQUAL

shapes.note: A tapscript k-of-n written with CHECKSIGADD. The threshold compare may be GREATERTHANOREQUAL instead of NUMEQUAL. Without the compare, the signature count itself is the result. This row is a name. The check is not written. Not an insert package.

shapes.title: Tagged key leaf

forms: key CHECKSIGVERIFY, then a short push
key CHECKSIGVERIFY, key CHECKSIGVERIFY, then a short push

shapes.note: A key leaf that ends in a short tag or commitment. Knots #481 counts that push as data and still treats the leaf as known. This row does not copy that count. This row is a name. The check is not written. Not an insert package.

shapes.title: CAT-21
shapes.note: This is the whole Knots check. The schema page only names the option and points at inscriptions. Inscriptions are a different row.

shapes.title: Runestone
shapes.note: Knots refuses this with -rejecttokens, so a strict node never hands it to the sidecar.

shapes.title: Counterparty

opreturn.decrypt: RC4 under the first input txid

shapes.note: The live check looks for the plaintext prefix. The chain form is encrypted, and Knots decrypts it.

schema.where: a length prefix, then the tag, then consecutive P2WSH output hashes

shapes.title: Fake multisig keys
shapes.note: Plumb counts a key as signed only when a signature in the spend verifies against it. A 2-of-3 stays out of this row. The same switch also marks SFS-32, the key beside CHECKSIG that the witness does not prove.

shapes.title: Dead branch
shapes.note: A branch decided by a signature or a witness item is not this row. OP_DEPTH OP_0NOTEQUAL OP_NOTIF, and a CHECKSIG that runs and fails, are SFS-32.

schema.script: only pushes, then OP_DROP or OP_2DROP
pushes, including the ord tag, dropped with OP_2DROP

shapes.title: Unnamed witness data

schema.input_data: counted by policy, and not one of the named witness rows

shapes.note: A holding row. It is not a check until the bytes have a name.

shapes.title: Swap memo
shapes.note: Fits an 83-byte OP_RETURN, so stock Knots relays it.

shapes.title: Babylon staking tag
shapes.note: The payment output is ordinary. The tag is the spam.

schema.exempt: the all-zero burn output beside it

shapes.title: ACME in P2WSH

schema.where: the OLGA framing with stamp: replaced by ACME

shapes.note: Four changed bytes walk past the stamp: check.

schema.program: 20 bytes that are payload, not a key hash

schema.output_script: counted as data, and not one of the named output rows

schema.not: a named prefix in this catalog
a named prefix or the 32-byte commitment

shapes.title: Inscription envelope
shapes.note: On this chain OP_IF in a tapscript is already invalid. The row stays so the name is not confused with cat21.

shapes.title: Heavy data
shapes.note: The switch marks a revealed tapscript at least this many bytes. A large OP_RETURN is the data-carrier mark.

shapes.title: Dust output
shapes.note: Does not match the Ark exit parent. A zero-value anchor on that parent is the whitelist, not dust.

shapes.title: Minimum fee
shapes.note: Mark a transaction under this fee so the node leaves it out of the block. It stays in the mempool.

shapes.title: Dust spray
shapes.note: Many outputs above zero and under a sat line. A zero output is an anchor, not spray.

shapes.title: Fan-out
shapes.note: One or two inputs paying many outputs that stay in the UTXO set. OP_RETURN does not count. A coinjoin has too many inputs.

shapes.title: Unverified key

patterns: OP_DEPTH OP_0NOTEQUAL OP_NOTIF around a key
<key> CHECKSIG DROP with an empty signature
a 32-byte tapscript key that never has to verify

shapes.note: The hole in Knots #422, added to the fake-multisig check. A key beside CHECKSIG counts only when this spend shows a signature for it. OP_DEPTH OP_0NOTEQUAL OP_NOTIF around a key is marked, and so is a key then CHECKSIG DROP when the signature item is empty. In tapscript a key is 32 bytes; more than ten of those without a signature item are marked. A full-size item still counts as a signature. Verifying that item is the node's job, which is the rest of Knots #470.

shapes.title: One small OP_RETURN
shapes.note: Too wide to mark. A named row in this file wins when the bytes match it.

shapes.title: Small output
shapes.note: Ordinary small payments and anchors. Shown, not marked.

shapes.title: Liquid emergency spend
shapes.note: Likely Liquid's own recovery. The layout can be copied, so it is not a whitelist. It is not enabled as spam either.
